source.description: Normalized evidence source label for UI, e.g. 'Device Syslog'.

severity.description: Normalized severity for display, e.g. info | warn | error | unknown.

summary.description: Short operator-facing summary of the event.

deviceName.description: Friendly device name when REAP can resolve it.

message.description: Optional raw or near-raw message text after REAP normalization.

matchReason.description: Optional explanation of why REAP included this event as evidence.
